content.short: Valos is a specialist investment manager offering institutional-quality strategies in digital assets.
content.description: Valos allocates into digital asset private credit, aiming at income and yield from disciplined exposure rather than directional risk. It publishes evidence-based reporting and states its fee structure in full, with returns shared on disclosed terms and no hidden charges. The firm works through strategic partnerships and extends its activity to Monad.
